card.name: Linking words in trial and evidence phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (and, to, by, a comma, Two) right after a word like controlled, benefit, supported or Surgery, in label sentences about clinical trials and evidence.

modes.label: After 'controlled'
modes.description: The word 'and' or a comma comes right after 'controlled' or 'well controlled' when describing trials.
modes.example: In 52 global controlled<< and>> uncontrolled clinical trials of adalimum

modes.label: Before trial descriptions
modes.description: 'Two' opens a sentence about large controlled trials after the CABG surgery heading.
modes.example: Status Post Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) Surgery<< Two>> large, controlled clinical trials of a CO

modes.label: Benefit or support phrases
modes.description: 'to' or 'by' follows 'benefit' or 'supported' in statements about evidence or benefit.
modes.example: Use of MERCAPTOPURINE in pediatrics is supported<< by>> evidence from the published literature and clinical experience

card.writes: It suppresses 'production' words, so it seems to steer the next word away from production terms.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words inside sentences about clinical trials and evidence.
